title: Zendesk Ticket Triage
summary: Classify every new Zendesk ticket with an LLM and write the priority and tags back as an internal note.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Zendesk API token used to register the webhook and update tickets.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN
secrets.description: Your Zendesk subdomain, for example `acme` for acme.zendesk.com.

setup: Connect Zendesk and add the two secrets above.
Publish the playbook; Ballet registers the Zendesk webhook for you.
Create a test ticket and watch the run in Studio.
